PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?ts ?point WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_top_ZN_2" .
  ?point rdfs:label "Perimeter_top_ZN_2" .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://example.org/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?p ?class ?ts ?label WHERE {
  ?p brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_top_ZN_2" .
  ?p brick:instancesOf ?class .
  OPTIONAL { ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts } .
  OPTIONAL { ?p rdfs:label ?label } .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://example.org/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?p ?class ?ts ?label WHERE {
  ?p brick:isPointOf / brick:hasSubgraph ?zone .
  FILTER(false)
}
